PROPOSED DATASET · FILES VERIFIED LOCAL

Published aggregate survey results on students' online learning, 2020–2021 — data extracted from Hatipoğlu et al. (2022)

Dataset · version 1.0 · compiled 4 October 2026 · proposed open access

Twenty-two published survey percentages covering difficulties with online learning and self-rated computer literacy. These are combined results across Türkiye, Poland, North Macedonia and Bosnia and Herzegovina.

FP: May–June 2020, total sample 216. SP: December 2020–January 2021, total sample 214.

Derived aggregate data. Values were transcribed from published results, with source-page references. This package contains no individual survey responses and is not the complete study dataset.

Proposed package licence: CC BY 4.0, with source attribution. Proposed file access: open download, no registration or embargo. The repository reviewer confirms both before release.
